# Lab 8.22: Right-size Access with Policy Intelligence

## What We Are Going to Do
Use the role recommender, Policy Analyzer and Policy Troubleshooter to find excess access and explain why access is allowed or denied.

## Steps

1. **List role recommendations.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud recommender recommendations list \
  --project=$PROJECT_ID \
  --location=global \
  --recommender=google.iam.policy.Recommender \
  --format="table(description,priority)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Recommendations are based on up to 90 days of usage. A new lab project may show few or none.

2. **See them in the console.** In **IAM**, the **Security insights** column shows a shield icon where a principal has unused permissions. Click it to see the smaller suggested role.

3. **Ask who has access with Policy Analyzer.** Find everyone who can delete Compute Engine instances in the project.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud asset analyze-iam-policy \
  --project=$PROJECT_ID \
  --full-resource-name=//cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID \
  --permissions=compute.instances.delete</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Ask why with Policy Troubleshooter.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud policy-intelligence troubleshoot-policy iam \
  //cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID \
  --principal-email=bob@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --permission=compute.instances.delete</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The output shows each binding that was checked, including deny policies, and whether it granted the permission.

5. **Apply a recommendation.** In the console, open a recommendation and click **Apply**. You can revert it later from the same page.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Recommender | Suggests smaller roles from real usage |
| Policy Analyzer | Answers who can do what |
| Policy Troubleshooter | Answers why access is allowed or denied |
| History | Applied recommendations can be reverted |
